examples.name: Return raw exception message
examples.before: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: "Unable to load the project." }, 500); }
examples.after: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: error.message }, 500); }

examples.name: Return stack trace
examples.before: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: "Unable to load the project." }, 500); }
examples.after: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: error.stack }, 500); }

examples.name: Return full exception object
examples.before: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: "Request failed." }, 500); }
examples.after: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error }, 500); }

examples.name: Sanitized failure response
examples.before: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: error.message }, 500); }
examples.after: export function failure(c, error) { return c.json({ error: "Unable to load the project. Try again." }, 500); }

examples.name: Safe not-found response
examples.after: export function missing(c) { return c.json({ error: "Project not found." }, 404); }

examples.name: Safe validation message
examples.after: export function invalid(c) { return c.json({ error: "Enter a valid project name." }, 400); }
